description: This file defines external protocol structures and functions for web configuration, including encoding and decoding for OVSDB, TR-181, and EasyMesh components, with conditional compilation based on EASY_MESH_NODE.

classes.name: webconfig_external_proto_t
classes.description: Union structure holding different external configuration schemas for OVSDB, TR-181, and EasyMesh.

methods.name: webconfig_ovsdb_encode
methods.description: Encodes webconfig object and external OVSDB schema into a string.

methods.name: webconfig_ovsdb_decode
methods.description: Decodes string into webconfig object and external OVSDB schema.

methods.name: webconfig_convert_ifname_to_subdoc_type
methods.description: Converts interface name to subdocument type.

methods.name: webconfig_easymesh_encode
methods.description: Encodes webconfig object and EasyMesh structure into a string.

methods.name: webconfig_easymesh_decode
methods.description: Decodes string into webconfig object and EasyMesh structure.
